slate-2.displayName: Slate 2 (declared as --slate-2; placed as rgb(22 29 40) in plate gradients)

gold-lo.displayName: Deep Gold (gradient stop; literal, no custom property)

cyan-deep.displayName: Deep Cyan (state fill of the transacting agent; literal, no custom property)

shade.displayName: Shade (mask ink and cast shadows; never a surface)

highlight.displayName: Highlight (white at low alpha: polished edge and reflections; never a surface)

display.purpose: The name in the hero. Syne 800 on two lines.

headline.purpose: Section headings and the closing heading. Syne 700.

title.purpose: The name of a case study.

title-plate.purpose: Names on plates. Shown at the venture size; a group note is clamp(1.7rem, 2.8vw, 2.4rem), a lab bench clamp(1.6rem, 2.4vw, 2.1rem), a contact key 1.3rem, the wordmark 1.05rem.

lead.purpose: The one sentence under the name, max 24ch.

lead-section.purpose: The paragraph beside a section heading, in ink-2, max 46ch.

lead-case.purpose: The challenge sentence that opens a case, max 34ch.

note.purpose: Supporting text one step below body small: hints, the scroll cue, figure scopes, venture role lines, field labels, demo list rows, the footer.

control.purpose: Small buttons and segmented options. Sample rows use the size at regular weight.

body-sm.purpose: Row detail, readouts, rail steps, meta lines.

label.purpose: Sentence-case column heads and list terms in steel-hi. Beside or under the thing named, never above a heading.

figure.purpose: The four figures in JetBrains Mono, tabular, with a half-size pale gold prefix. The gauge score is 2.2rem.

data.purpose: Log lines, ledger cells and audit rows. 0.78rem to 0.8125rem for the clock, repository links, date windows and key values.

shadows.name: polished-edge
shadows.purpose: The one highlight on a plate. 0.07 to 0.08 on near-opaque plates, 0.12 to 0.14 on blurred glass.

shadows.name: plate-float
shadows.purpose: Under the figures strip. 0 60px 100px -60px #000 for a stage, -70px spread for a bench, 0 30px 50px -30px #000 for a key.

shadows.name: bezel-cast
shadows.purpose: Filter on the steel bezel image.

shadows.name: crystal
shadows.purpose: Rim shade over the portrait, with a 7 percent white reflection at 118deg.

shadows.name: recess
shadows.purpose: Date window. 0.7 alpha on the switch track.

shadows.name: gold-line-glow
shadows.purpose: The seconds mark. 0.55 alpha on the leader line; 8px at 0.95 on the payment pulse in the gateway diagram.

shadows.name: glass-control
shadows.purpose: The inspect switch riding on the portrait.

shadows.name: hotspot-core
shadows.purpose: The gold core of a hotspot, ringed in obsidian so it holds on the photo.

shadows.name: live-pulse
shadows.purpose: The emerald live dot, 2.2s ease-out, infinite.

shadows.name: print-preview
shadows.purpose: Under the dossier sheet when previewed on screen. It does not print.

shadows.name: glass-blur
shadows.purpose: Scrolled top bar. 14px on the inspect switch, 18px on contact keys, 20px and saturate(1.35) on the figures strip. Only where a picture or the sheen is behind.

shadows.name: pointer-light
shadows.value: radial-gradient(460px circle at var(--gx) var(--gy), rgb(212 175 55 / 0.09), transparent 62%)
shadows.purpose: Follows a mouse pointer on a stage. 340px at 0.16 on a venture, 240px at 0.22 on a key, 520px cyan at 0.07 on a bench.

shadows.name: dial-sheen
shadows.value: radial-gradient(540px circle at var(--sx) var(--sy), rgb(212 175 55 / 0.11), transparent 66%) over a 104deg steel band at 0.075
shadows.purpose: The light on the dial grooves. Its position follows the pointer.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing for interface transitions (EASE.out, --ease-out).

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Line drawing and exits (EASE.inOut).

motion.name: spring-loupe
motion.purpose: The loupe follows the pointer.

motion.name: spring-iris
motion.purpose: The loupe mask opens to the whole portrait.

motion.name: spring-magnet
motion.value: stiffness 220, damping 16, mass 0.5; 0.3 of the pointer offset, 0.18 for contact keys
motion.purpose: Magnetic actions. Mouse only.

motion.name: spring-counter
motion.purpose: Figures count up once; the final value is always in the HTML.

motion.name: spring-hand
motion.purpose: Sub-dial hands.

motion.name: spring-needle
motion.purpose: The sentiment gauge needle.

motion.name: segmented-thumb
motion.purpose: The gold thumb of a segmented control.

motion.name: variant-swap
motion.value: in: opacity 0, y 14, blur 8px to rest, 0.6s; out: y -10, blur 6px, 0.22s
motion.purpose: One view replaces another in the same frame.

motion.name: variant-detail
motion.value: height 0 to auto and opacity, 0.5s in, 0.25s out
motion.purpose: A row opens to show its detail.

motion.name: variant-log-line
motion.purpose: A new line lands in a log.

motion.name: variant-leader
motion.purpose: The gold leader line from a hotspot to its row.

motion.name: scroll-heading
motion.value: lines rise 108 percent from a mask, 1.05s, stagger 0.09s, expo.out, once at top 88%
motion.purpose: Headings (GSAP SplitText).

motion.name: scroll-item
motion.value: y 28 and autoAlpha 0 to rest, 0.95s, stagger 0.07s, expo.out, at top 92%
motion.purpose: Small items below the fold.

motion.name: scroll-draw
motion.purpose: SVG strokes and minute-track rules draw as they enter.

motion.name: hero-timeline
motion.value: portrait from scale 0.93 and blur 14px over 1.9s; name characters rise 1.15s, stagger 0.04s, from 0.1s; lead lines from 0.55s; actions from 0.85s; track from 0.9s
motion.purpose: First-screen entrance.

motion.name: case-progress
motion.value: --p 0 to 1, scrub 0.5, top top to bottom bottom; (min-width: 1000px) and (min-height: 700px)
motion.purpose: A pinned case lights its strategy rail with the scroll.

motion.name: art-drift
motion.purpose: Section pictures move slightly against the scroll.

motion.name: seconds-sweep
motion.purpose: The gold seconds mark goes once round the bezel track each minute.

motion.name: hotspot-ping
motion.value: scale 0.45 to 1.25 and fade, 2.6s, delay 320ms per hotspot
motion.purpose: The ring on a resting hotspot.

motion.name: fold
motion.purpose: The hero swaps its actions for the leadership stack without moving the name.

motion.name: lenis
motion.purpose: Smooth scroll, off under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No GSAP, Lenis, magnetism or springs; seconds mark, ping and live pulse stop; all content visible and still.

motion.name: failsafe
motion.purpose: If the page script never starts, hidden entrance items are shown.

narrative.overview:
The page is a steel sports watch seen in low light. The ground is the dial: near-black obsidian cut with wide horizontal grooves, with a soft sheen that follows the pointer across them. The dial is fixed behind every section and never changes colour. One object on the page is photographed metal: a steel cushion bezel, laid around the portrait as a nine-slice frame, with a minute track and a gold seconds mark running round it. A steel loupe follows the pointer over the portrait and shows the second picture inside its ring.

Everything else borrows the watch's own parts. Panels are smoked-glass plates with one polished top edge. Rules are minute tracks: a hairline with short ticks, and a longer tick every fifth mark. Figures sit beside small sub-dial registers whose gold hand swings to its mark. Dates sit in recessed date windows. Buttons are chronograph pushers. Colour follows a strict reading: gold is the hand and the one part that is active, emerald means live or approved, cyan means data moving through a system. There is no red; a rejected or removed state is shown in pale gold with a dashed line or a written word.

Type has three jobs and three faces. Syne sets names and headings, heavy and tight. Inter sets everything that is read. JetBrains Mono sets data only: figures, clocks, log lines, ledger rows, addresses. The page is dark throughout, and it is complete without hover, without scripts and with reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: One obsidian dial under every section, with horizontal grooves and a pointer sheen.
One photographed steel bezel, used once, around the portrait.
Smoked-glass plates with a single polished top edge and a deep, soft shadow below.
Minute-track ticks as rules, sub-dial registers for figures, date windows for dates.
Gold for the hand and the active part; emerald for live or approved; cyan for data in transit.
Syne for names, Inter for reading, JetBrains Mono for data only.
Sentence case everywhere; no uppercase tracked labels.

rules.name: The One Hand Rule
rules.body: Gold marks the one active part of a view: the action, the selected option, the item in focus, the point on a scale. A resting plate, a paragraph or a section ground is never gold. Pale gold text is allowed on one item per group.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Emerald means live or approved. Cyan means data in transit. Neither is decoration, and neither appears outside an instrument, a diagram or a status.

rules.name: The Two Palettes Rule
rules.body: The `print-*` colours belong to the print dossier and the rest belong to the page. No colour crosses from one surface to the other.

rules.name: The No Red Rule
rules.body: The build has no red. A rejected or removed state is pale gold with a dashed stroke or a written word, so the state never depends on colour alone.

rules.name: The One Dial Rule
rules.body: The ground is the obsidian dial in every section. A section changes by what is set on the dial (a plate, a stage, a masked picture), never by a new ground colour or a light section.

rules.name: The Three Faces Rule
rules.body: Syne sets names and headings only. Inter sets every sentence, label and button. JetBrains Mono sets data only: numbers, times, addresses, repository paths and log text. Mono never sets a heading, a label or a paragraph.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Nothing is set in uppercase and no text is letter-spaced wide. Tracking is zero or negative. Hierarchy comes from face, weight, size and the steel ramp.

rules.name: The Under, Not Over Rule
rules.body: A small line sits under or beside the name it describes (role and dates under a venture, kind under a bench). No small label sits above a heading to name the section.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes or lines up in a column uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Polished Edge Rule
rules.body: A plate has exactly one highlight, a 1px inner line along its top edge. No plate has a highlight on a side or a coloured border at rest.

rules.name: The Straight Down Rule
rules.body: Cast shadows fall straight down, are black, and are pulled in by a negative spread close to their offset. No shadow is offset sideways, hard-edged or coloured, except the gold glow under a gold part.

rules.name: The Glass Needs Something Behind It Rule
rules.body: Blur a plate only when a picture or the sheen is behind it. Over plain ground a plate is a near-opaque gradient.

dos: Do keep the obsidian dial under every section and change sections by what is set on it.
Do give each view one gold part: the action, the selected option or the item in focus. Put `on-gold` text on a gold fill.
Do use emerald only for live or approved, and cyan only for data in transit.
Do build a panel as a plate: a dark gradient, a `line` outline, one 1px polished top edge and a straight-down black shadow with a negative spread.
Do blur a plate only when a picture or the dial sheen is behind it.
Do rule with minute ticks (12px apart, a long tick every 60px), put figures beside a sub-dial register and put dates in a date window.
Do set names and headings in Syne 700 or 800 with tracking of -0.02em to -0.035em, everything read in Inter, and data in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.
Do scale corner radius with the part, from 7px for a date window to 28px for a stage, and keep a nested radius smaller than its parent.
Do mask a picture into the dial with a gradient and lay an obsidian scrim under the text.
Do show a rejected or removed state in pale gold with a dashed stroke or a written word.
Do keep all content present with no hover, no script and reduced motion, and read motion timing from `src/lib/motion.ts`.
Do keep buttons at 52px, standalone controls at 44px or more, and compact controls inside an instrument at 40px.
donts: Don't introduce a light section, a second ground colour or a coloured section band on the main page. Light paper belongs to the print dossier only.
Don't use gold for a resting plate, a paragraph or a section ground, or make two unrelated things gold at rest in one view.
Don't use emerald or cyan as decoration, as a heading colour or as a button for navigation.
Don't add red. The system has no red.
Don't set a heading, a label or a paragraph in JetBrains Mono, and don't set data in Syne.
Don't set text in uppercase or with wide letter-spacing, and don't place a small label above a heading to name the section.
Don't use a hard, sideways or coloured cast shadow. Gold glow belongs under gold parts only.
Don't add a second photographed frame. The steel bezel is used once, on the portrait.
Don't box a picture in a card. Pictures sit behind a section, masked at the edges.
Don't use `steel-lo` or `rail` for text; they are stroke colours.
Don't carry the dial, glass or glow into the print dossier, or the dossier's light palette into the page.
